integrity: Theorem proved from exact Gram reduction, integer polynomial identities, and positive-root asymptotics; finite standard-library tests corroborate but do not establish all-dimensional conclusions. Novelty remains provisional under uninspected full 2021 article.
limitations: Binary Walsh spectrum through degree two on Hamming balls, fixed minimal radius for asymptotics; no claims for arbitrary sampling sets, noise, or growing bandwidth. A 2021 closely related article was only accessible as publisher preview, leaving historical priority risk.
title: Exact quadratic Walsh concentration on Hamming balls and the sharp minimal-sampling instability
